param.name: presence_pct
param.label: Minimum presence fraction
param.help: Retain genes expressed (non-zero) in at least this fraction of samples. Default: 0.60

param.name: var_percentile
param.label: Variance percentile cutoff
param.help: Remove genes below this variance percentile. Default: 40

param.name: soft_power
param.label: Soft-thresholding power β (0 = auto-detect)
param.help: Network adjacency power. 0 = automatic from scale-free topology fit. Inspect the soft-threshold plot if auto fails.

param.name: network_type
param.label: Network type
param.option: Unsigned — treats up and down equally

param.name: min_module_size
param.label: Minimum module size
param.help: Smallest permitted co-expression module (number of genes). Default: 50

param.name: merge_cut_height
param.label: Module merging cut height
param.help: Modules with eigengene correlation ≥ (1 − height) are merged. Default: 0.25

param.name: max_block_size
param.label: Maximum block size
param.help: Max genes per computational block. Reduce if RAM is limited. Default: 5000

param.name: n_threads
param.label: Threads
param.help: Parallel threads for WGCNA. Default: 4

param.name: kme_threshold
param.label: |kME| threshold for core module genes
param.help: Only genes with |module membership| above this value are exported to Cytoscape and used in enrichment. Default: 0.80

param.name: cor_threshold
param.label: Module-trait |r| threshold
param.help: Only modules with |Pearson r| ≥ this value are selected for export and enrichment. Default: 0.60

param.name: tom_percentile
param.label: TOM edge percentile cutoff
param.help: Only edges in the top (1 − percentile) of TOM weight are exported. Default: 0.95

param.name: orgdb_package
param.label: Organism annotation database (OrgDb)
param.help: Bioconductor OrgDb package for GO annotation. Select the organism matching your data.

param.name: orgdb_custom
param.label: Custom OrgDb package name
param.help: Only used when 'Custom' is selected above. E.g. org.Zm.eg.db for maize.

param.name: gene_id_type
param.label: Gene identifier type in your data
param.help: The type of gene IDs in your expression matrix row names.

param.name: run_kegg
param.label: Also run KEGG pathway enrichment
param.help: Runs enrichKEGG in addition to GO. Requires internet access and a KEGG organism code.

param.name: kegg_organism
param.label: KEGG organism code
param.help: 3-4 letter KEGG code, e.g. hsa (human), mmu (mouse), ath (Arabidopsis), sce (yeast), dme (Drosophila).

param.name: enrich_pval_cut
param.label: Adjusted p-value cutoff
param.help: Terms with adjusted p-value above this are discarded. Default: 0.05

param.name: enrich_qval_cut
param.label: q-value cutoff
param.help: Additional q-value filter. Default: 0.20

param.name: enrich_min_gs
param.label: Minimum gene-set size
param.help: Discard GO terms annotating fewer than this many genes. Default: 10

param.name: enrich_max_gs
param.label: Maximum gene-set size
param.help: Discard GO terms annotating more than this many genes. Default: 500

param.name: pres_n_perms
param.label: Number of permutations
param.help: More permutations → more accurate Z-scores, but longer runtime. Default: 200

param.name: pres_max_genes
param.label: Maximum genes for preservation test
param.help: Genes per module are subsampled to this limit. Reduces runtime. Default: 2000

param.name: pres_random_seed
param.label: Random seed
param.help: For reproducibility of permutation results. Default: 12345
